info.name: HustleHub+ Backend Demo
info.description: Backend-only demo run. Restart the API before each run so the auth rate limiter starts at zero.

exec: pm.test("Register client: response has no password", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().user).to.not.have.property("password"));
pm.test("Register freelancer: response has no password", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().user).to.not.have.property("password"));
pm.test("Register second freelancer: response has no password", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().user).to.not.have.property("password"));
pm.test("Login second freelancer: role is freelancer", () => pm.expect(body.user.role).to.eql("freelancer"));
pm.test("Wrong password: generic message", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Incorrect email or password."));
pm.test("Profile with valid client token: 200", () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

item.name: Create gig with script in title
